evals.prompt: Rename one local variable. Touch only this line.
evals.expected_output: Uses surgical/light path; no multi-agent ceremony.

evals.prompt: Use Thalarch. This test started failing after recent commits. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Debug path before editing.

evals.prompt: Add a multi-file feature with ambiguous behavior and keep backward compatibility.
evals.expected_output: Spec/acceptance matrix before implementation.

evals.prompt: Redesign this screen but keep all current functions.
evals.expected_output: UI path with visual thesis and runtime evidence.

evals.prompt: Fix the GitHub Actions failure and do not publish anything.
evals.expected_output: CI diagnosis with side-effect boundary.

evals.prompt: Review this authentication change for security.
evals.expected_output: Security lens with source-to-sink/authz reasoning.

evals.prompt: Implement and push a branch and open a PR.
evals.expected_output: External actions permitted because explicit.

evals.prompt: Make this Compose screen adaptive and test on device.
evals.expected_output: Kotlin/Android route plus device/emulator evidence.
expectations: Compilation not treated as runtime proof

evals.prompt: Use Thalarch. Build a complete premium website for a small architecture studio. Make it memorable, not a generic SaaS template.
evals.expected_output: Web-design route with product-specific art direction and a semantic design system before implementation.

evals.prompt: Use Thalarch. Create a cinematic hero image for this website using the attached brand image only as a palette/style reference.
evals.expected_output: Image generation route that labels the attachment as a reference instead of an edit target.

evals.prompt: Use Thalarch. In this photo change only the jacket from red to black. Everything else must stay the same.
evals.expected_output: Invariant-preserving edit plus before/after visual QA.

evals.prompt: Use Thalarch. Add the generated hero artwork to the landing page and make it work beautifully on mobile and desktop.
evals.expected_output: Combined web + image integration route followed by real browser visual review.
expectations: Generated mockup not treated as implementation proof

evals.prompt: Use Thalarch. Fix this Java service on its current JDK. Do not upgrade Java or Spring. The method I think exists may be version-specific.
evals.expected_output: Java specialist discovers real JDK/framework versions and verifies APIs before coding.

evals.prompt: Use Thalarch. This Kotlin Flow intermittently loses UI events. Find the cause and fix it without changing app architecture.
evals.expected_output: Causal debugging plus Kotlin coroutine/Flow specialist reasoning.

evals.prompt: Use Thalarch. Optimize this Python endpoint. Do not add dependencies unless measurement proves we need one.
evals.expected_output: Python + performance route with baseline/profiling before optimization.

evals.prompt: Use Thalarch. Refactor this TypeScript module with exactly the same external behavior.
evals.expected_output: Refactor + TypeScript route with behavior baseline and compiler strictness preserved.

evals.prompt: Use Thalarch. This Go worker occasionally leaks goroutines under cancellation. Fix and prove it.
evals.expected_output: Go specialist plus causal concurrency debugging and race/lifecycle evidence.

evals.prompt: Use Thalarch. Review and modify this Rust unsafe parsing boundary without expanding the unsafe surface.
evals.expected_output: Rust specialist treats unsafe as a proof obligation and keeps the surface minimal.

evals.prompt: Use Thalarch. Change the Kotlin Android client and Python backend to evolve one shared API without breaking old clients.
evals.expected_output: Polyglot route with explicit shared compatibility contract and separate language specialists.

evals.prompt: Use Thalarch. Upgrade this dependency to fix the bug, but do not update anything unrelated.
evals.expected_output: Dependency migration route with exact-version API/compatibility verification.
